_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json | ADR-044 cards-collapse
_meta.description: Collapses the Service top-level navigation group into a single clickable menu item (ADR-044). The Service menu entry is given a route pointing to ServiceHubOverview so it behaves as a leaf, not an expandable parent group. The former child leaves (Requests, Tasks, Contactmomenten, Complaints, Projects, MyWork, BookingsGroup, Queues) become cards on the hub page. All leaf page routes remain registered; their ids are listed in src/menu-layout.json#removals so the nav nesting is removed while the pages stay routable.
